svg.aria-label: Terminal: $ npm install vlm-code-context-mcp | # the code index: 6 tools, the default | $ npx code-context-reindex . --db ./context.db | $ claude mcp add code-context -- npx code-context ./context.db | # or the sprint process instead (adds 91 tools): | $ npx code-context-mcp setup . # code-context-sprint | $ npx code-context-dashboard ./context.db # :3333
